retrievers.label: Nearest neighbour
retrievers.summary: Ranks ontology terms by character n-gram similarity to the question.

retrievers.label: Pattern matching
retrievers.summary: Matches question words against labels and local names.

retrievers.label: SPARQL query
retrievers.summary: Runs the query in the editor. Every IRI it returns is retrieved.

retrievers.label: Cypher query
retrievers.summary: Runs the query in the editor against Neo4j. Needs NEO4J_URI.

retrievers.label: Your retriever
retrievers.summary: Upload a Python file that defines retrieve(question, graph, k).

reasoners.label: Path-based
reasoners.summary: Shortest paths between retrieved terms over subclass and property edges.

reasoners.label: Rule-based (Horn clause)
reasoners.summary: Forward-chains RDFS and OWL Horn rules: subclass, domain, range, inverse, transitive.

reasoners.label: AMIE rules
reasoners.summary: Applies Horn rules that AMIE mines from the graph's instance facts.

reasoners.label: LLM agent
reasoners.summary: An Ollama model answers from the assembled context.

reasoners.label: No reasoning
reasoners.summary: Pass the retrieved terms to the context as they are.

context.label: Only saved questions with the same intent
